newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAB GREETS COMPETITION BOARD INVESTIGATION.
newsitem.headline: SAB GREETS COMPETITION BOARD INVESTIGATION.

text.p: Drinks giant South African Breweries Ltd said on Monday it welcomed an investigation by the country's Competition Board into the liquour industry and pledged its cooperation.

Late last month board chairman Pierre Brooks said he planned to probe the effects of wine co-operative KWV's plans to convert itself into a company, shareholdings by KWV and SAB in enterprises with which they compete, SAB's distribution system and "other related matters."
SAB said in a statement that the move would allow SAB to set the record straight about its operations and counter recent negative stories in the media.

"SAB is confident that the work of the Competition Board will...promote the emergence of a balanced perspectiove on the way in which the company conducts its business," said SAB Beer managing director Norman Adami.
Adami said the firm would cooperate fully with the report. "We have nothing to hide," he said.
SAB dominates the South African beer market and has been engaged in an often bitter war of words with comparatively tiny Namibian Breweries , which has been making steady inroads into the market.
